claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh deployed v0.15.166 browser evidence where finish applied 16 repairs but still emitted dangling-clause export warnings with zero finish retry actions.

claims.summary: The package finalizer now has a separate retryContentQualityWarnings option so known content-quality defects can enter the retry queue without enabling all broad warning retries.
AppFlow enables the content-quality retry switch only for export-triggered package finishing, preserving cost control for sync/background passes.
proofCommands: rg -n "Enable that option only for export-triggered" docs/V0.15.168_CONTENT_QUALITY_RETRY_ROADMAP.md

claims.summary: The focused regression uses a surviving student-facing content-quality warning and proves export finish produces a concrete retry target without relaxing the warning.
The release explicitly does not claim a fresh clean ZIP score; deployed v0.15.168 still needs a GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit.
proofCommands: rg -n "may not claim|fresh v0.15.168|ZIP/log audit" docs/V0.15.168_CONTENT_QUALITY_RETRY_ROADMAP.md release-contracts/v0.15.168.json
